Chamber is opened!
Afk for 24 hours to get Early Access and play a day before everyone else!

Welcome to Anime CardVerse! 

🃏 Collect powers inspired by your favourite anime universes and fight your way to victory!

✨ FEATURES ✨
🔥 Unlock unique Powers, each with its own signature Passives
⚔️ Pair Weapons with your Powers for devastating combos
💎 Build your loadout with Gears, Traits, and Stat Potentials
🌍 Battle through multiple Worlds and Questlines
🏆 Take on Challenges for bountiful treasures
🛒 Catch the Travelling Merchant for rare deals
🧬 Evolve your powers to unleash their full potential
🎟️ Climb the Season Pass for exclusive rewards

🎮 Supports Mobile, Tablet, PC, and Console
🔒 Private servers are FREE!

🎁 Join the group, 👍 like and ⭐ favorite the game for free rewards!

Disclaimer: All content is fan-made and inspired. Please contact us for any concerns.
